workflow_stage: parameter selection before the final 68-specimen atlas
final_atlas_policy: Kernel width 0.1 was retained without further tuning when Rhynchites cupreus was added to the final 68-specimen atlas.
interpretation_limit: The five archived runs quantify stability of the development-stage 67-specimen ordinations. They document parameter selection but are not sensitivity reruns of the final 68-specimen atlas and do not establish that width 0.1 is uniquely optimal.
